window-1.title: laurel.world — Laurel Schwulst's site
window-1.blurb: It's less a portfolio than a soft cream-colored room you wander through, where every project links sideways to another by year, medium, or friend — the kind of hand-made web object that'll make you want to rebuild your own site by midnight.

window-2.title: Cool but not “cool cool” — Kiko Mizuhara on Blackbird Spyplane
window-2.blurb: Spyplane at its goofiest and most obsessive, interviewing a Tokyo shapeshifter who acts, models, and designs — basically your side-quest energy in interview form.

window-3.title: Spiced Tamarind Mocktail
window-3.blurb: Sour, salty, gingery chaat energy in a glass — it's the rare mocktail that tastes like a snack stall instead of a juice bar, and the kala namak makes it weirdly addictive.

window-4.title: Ignant — Interiors & Home Visits
window-4.blurb: It's a rolling feed of real people's homes — the kind stacked with books, odd ceramics and lamps with a story — and you'll want to rearrange your whole living room within ten minutes of scrolling.
